contract.description: Generate a real TIA watch-table SimaticML document (.xml) from a structured plan. Mutating; writes a file when output_path is given, otherwise returns the xml string. The real element types are SW.WatchAndForceTables.PlcWatchTableEntry and <Name> — do not invent SW.WatchAndForceTables.WatchItem or a <TagName> child. Plain UTF-8, no BOM. Import with tia_openness_import_watch_table_xml; ok:true here means shape correctness only, not a confirmed TIA import.

entry.description: One watch row. Provide `name` (the symbolic operand, e.g. "\"DB_Motor\".StartPB" or a tag name) which is emitted as <Name>, and/or `address` (the absolute operand, e.g. %M0.0 or %DB1.DBX0.0) emitted as <Address> — at least one is required. Optional fields map 1:1 to the proven PlcWatchTableEntry property element names and are written only when present. The on-disk token form of enum fields is import-confirmed, so unknown tokens warn but do not block.

address.description: Absolute operand -> <Address> ("Address of watch table entry"), e.g. %M0.0.

display_format.description: -> <DisplayFormat>. Proven PlcWatchAndForceTableDisplayFormat members (exact case): Undef, Any_pointer, BCD, Bin, Bool, Character, Character_sequence, Date, DATE_AND_TIME, DEC_sequence, DEC_signed, DEC_unsigned, Hex, Block_number, Octal, Pointer, Float, Counter, SIMATIC_Time, String, Time, TIME_OF_DAY, Unicode_character, Unicode_character_sequence, Unicode_string, Symbolic. No enum is used for OpenAI compatibility.

modify_trigger.description: -> <ModifyTrigger>. Same PreDefinedTrigger member set as monitor_trigger.

modify_value.description: -> <ModifyValue>, the value used when modifying (e.g. true, 100, 16#FF).

monitor_trigger.description: -> <MonitorTrigger>. Proven PlcWatchAndForceTablePreDefinedTrigger members: Permanent, PermanentAtStart, OnceOnlyAtStart, PermanentAtEnd, OnceOnlyAtEnd, PermanentAtStop, OnceOnlyAtStop, Undef.

name.description: Symbolic operand -> <Name> ("Tag name of watch table entry").

entries.description: Watch table rows. Each row becomes a SW.WatchAndForceTables.PlcWatchTableEntry. A bare string is treated as {name}.

schema_version.description: TIA version for the <Engineering version> attribute. Accepts V16-V21 (V15 is rejected); emitted verbatim — a real V21 watch export carries version="V21". Omitted defaults to the project's openness_version (plc-code.project.json).

table_name.description: Watch table display name, emitted as the PlcWatchTable AttributeList <Name>. For example 监控梯形图逻辑.

contract.name: tia_watch_generate_table_xml
